              1.Coastal Engineering
2.Environmental engineering
3.Hydraulics
4.Measurement technology
5.Regional cooperation

              This course will tackle problem solving with an engineering approach to all problems in water from the viewpoints of coastal engineering, coastal environmental engineering, river engineering, and disaster prevention engineering. Specifically, we will try to solve problems using experiments, measurements, and numerical simulations, and present the results in papers and presentations.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In the first semester, we will conduct a literature survey on the background of research themes and previous studies, and summarize the novelty and methods of research.

In the second half, data will be collected for experiments, measurements, and numerical calculations. Analyze and consider from the data obtained from them. Summarize the results of your research in papers and presentation materials.
